science.title: Apple Faces 'Planned Obsolescence' Trial Over iPhone Repairs
science.summary: Apple will face trial in France in June 2027 over allegations that it restricted independent iPhone repairs, French advocacy group Halte à l'Obsolescence Programmée (HOP) this week announced. The case follows HOP's December 2022 complaint about parts pairing, which electronically links components to a specific iPhone.
